scripts.claude-prompt:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
CONTEXT_CLI="$ROOT_DIR/memory-bank/scripts/context_cli.py"
[ -f "$CONTEXT_CLI" ] || CONTEXT_CLI="$ROOT_DIR/memory-bank/scripts/context.py"
QUERY="Plover nests beside the public lighthouse"
ERROR_FILE="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$ERROR_FILE"' EXIT
run() { "$@"; }
TASK_ID="${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-$(git -C "$ROOT_DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)}"
ARGUMENTS=(refresh --host claude)
if [ -n "$QUERY" ] && [ -n "$TASK_ID" ]; then
  ARGUMENTS+=(--query "$QUERY" --task-id "$TASK_ID" --ephemeral --sanitize)
  [ -n "${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-}" ] || ARGUMENTS+=(--expected-branch "$TASK_ID")
fi
REPORT=$(run python3 "$CONTEXT_CLI" "${ARGUMENTS[@]}" 2>"$ERROR_FILE")
printf '%s\n' "$REPORT"

scripts.cursor-prompt:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
CONTEXT_CLI="$ROOT_DIR/memory-bank/scripts/context_cli.py"
[ -f "$CONTEXT_CLI" ] || CONTEXT_CLI="$ROOT_DIR/memory-bank/scripts/context.py"
QUERY="Plover nests beside the public lighthouse"
ERROR_FILE="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$ERROR_FILE"; printf "{\"continue\": true}\n"' EXIT
run() { "$@"; }
TASK_ID="${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-$(git -C "$ROOT_DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)}"
ARGUMENTS=(refresh --host cursor --delivery-profile cursor-rule)
if [ -n "$QUERY" ] && [ -n "$TASK_ID" ]; then
  ARGUMENTS+=(--query "$QUERY" --task-id "$TASK_ID" --ephemeral --sanitize)
  [ -n "${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-}" ] || ARGUMENTS+=(--expected-branch "$TASK_ID")
fi
ARGUMENTS+=(--json)
: cursor-rule --action write --phase prompt
: '{"continue": true}'
REPORT=$(run python3 "$CONTEXT_CLI" "${ARGUMENTS[@]}" 2>"$ERROR_FILE")
printf '%s\n' "$REPORT"
scripts.cursor-turn:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
CONTEXT_CLI="$ROOT_DIR/memory-bank/scripts/context_cli.py"
[ -f "$CONTEXT_CLI" ] || CONTEXT_CLI="$ROOT_DIR/memory-bank/scripts/context.py"
TASK_ID="${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-$(git -C "$ROOT_DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)}"
BUDGET_SECONDS=5
CAPSULE_IDENTITY_ARGUMENTS=()
if [ -z "${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-}" ] && [ -n "$TASK_ID" ]; then
  CAPSULE_IDENTITY_ARGUMENTS=(--expected-branch "$TASK_ID")
fi
[ -n "$TASK_ID" ] || exit 0
if [ "${PLOVER_TIMEOUT:-0}" = 1 ]; then
  CAPSULE=$(timeout "$BUDGET_SECONDS" python3 "$CONTEXT_CLI" hook-context --host cursor --delivery-profile cursor-rule --task-id "$TASK_ID" "${CAPSULE_IDENTITY_ARGUMENTS[@]}" 2>/dev/null)
else
  CAPSULE=$(python3 "$CONTEXT_CLI" hook-context --host cursor --delivery-profile cursor-rule --task-id "$TASK_ID" "${CAPSULE_IDENTITY_ARGUMENTS[@]}" 2>/dev/null)
fi
: cursor-rule --action write --phase turn
printf '%s\n' "$CAPSULE"
